correctness.rationale: For arbitrary deterministic positive weights, p_j=w_j/W_j in (0,1), the actual innovation-variance recurrence v_{j+1}=(1-p_j^2)v_j+p_j(1-p_j) with v_2=0 is cited from Gałązka--Wdowicka Proposition 5.3 and is independently consistent with parent-choice conditioning. Completing the square gives v_{j+1}=G(v_j)-(v_j+1)(p_j-1/[2(v_j+1)])^2, G(x)=x+1/[4(x+1)] strictly increasing for x>=0. Thus induction gives attained B_{j+1}=G(B_j) and unique fractions p_j=1/[2(B_j+1)] for j<n; all such fractions correspond to positive weights. Subtraction yields the exact nonnegative stability recursion. Squared shift b_{j+1}^2-b_j^2=1/2+1/(16b_j^2), b_j^2=j/2+O(log j), leads to (B_n+1)^2=n/2+(log n)/8+O(1). Independently recomputed exact rational deficit for four nonoptimal fractions, equality and dominance at every step; no numerical extrapolation proves the asymptotic.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The general arbitrary-weight recurrence is broader as a starting relation but does not itself state a maximization theorem or rigidity; a separate monotone dynamic programming argument and asymptotic summation are required.
